BiblicalUsage: Jozadak is named 5 times in the Bible, and the passages here are Ezra 3:2; Ezra 3:8; Nehemiah 12:26. In Ezra 3:2 we read, "Then stood up Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren the priests, and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel..." It appears again in Nehemiah 12:26: "These were in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor..."
TheologicalSignificance: Jozadak is written down once, and I take that as proof God counts individuals. A name like this one reminds me that God forgets no one.
